description: Log period start dates to estimate average cycle length, next period, and fertile window.

faqs.a: The average of the gaps between logged start dates. Log at least 3 periods for a steadier average.
Ovulation is estimated ~14 days before the next period; the fertile window covers 5 days before to 1 day after ovulation.
faqs.q: How is the fertile window estimated?

faqs.a: It is a rough estimate for awareness only — not reliable for contraception or conception planning. Talk to a clinician.
faqs.q: Can I rely on these predictions?

howto: Log the start date of each period.
After 2+ entries, see your average cycle length.
Check the predicted next period date.
